name: @vibestudio/desktop
description: VibeStudio standalone desktop shell (Electron). Wraps the web app and packages to a Windows .exe.

scripts.dist: npm run prepare:server && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:server && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:server && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:server && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder --linux
